title: pvPointSetToOctreeImage
body:
## pvPointSetToOctreeImage

Bins a point set (point cloud or any vtkPointSet) into a uniform image covering the points' bounding box, sized so that each cell holds about NumberOfPointsPerCell points. The output (a partitioned dataset containing one image) has an unsigned-char cell array "octree" whose eight bits record which octants of each cell contain points, and optionally a float cell array, named after a chosen single-component point array, with per-cell last value, min, max, count, sum and/or mean components. Use it to voxelize particle or LiDAR data, or with pvOctreeImagetoPointSet as a compact, lossy point-cloud encoding.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- NumberOfPointsPerCell must not exceed the number of input points, otherwise the filter fails.
- With ProcessInputPointArray true, the array must have one component and at least one Compute option must be on; ComputeMean also adds Count and Sum components.
- LastValue is not deterministic under multithreading; prefer Mean, Min or Max for reproducible results.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PointSetToOctreeImage`. Identity: `filters/PointSetToOctreeImage`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeCount` | Set if the count of the values for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeLastValue` | Set if the last value for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeMax` | Set if the max value for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeMean` | Set if the mean value for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeMin` | Set if the min value for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeSum` | Set if the sum of the values for each cell id of the point array will be computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `NumberOfPointsPerCell` | Set the average number of points in each cell of the output image. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PointArray` | The value of this property contains the name of the scalar point array to be processed. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ProcessInputPointArray` | Set if input point array should be processed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
